links.comparator_used: Pre-intervention and post-intervention cases without a huddle, i.e. no linked huddle response to the sepsis alert
links.outcome: Antibiotic treatment of IPSO sepsis cases
links.effect: Without a huddle, treatment was similar pre- vs post-intervention (9.3% vs 10.5%); with the alert-driven huddle it was 22.7%.
links.tradeoff: NASA Task Load Index rose from 43 to 57 post-intervention (slight workload increase). Only 28% (555/1977) of huddles occurred without an alert firing, suggesting some automation bias.
links.quote: Treatment with antibiotics for IPSO sepsis cases was similar pre- and post-intervention without a huddle (9.3% vs 10.5%), though treatment doubled with huddle intervention (22.7%).

design_hint: alert-triggered sepsis huddle with human performance monitoring
